verdict.rationale: Pulley is an equity-management SaaS that could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring workflows, so the axis applies. The pack shows no user-configurable recurring jobs or schedules. Automatic vesting-event emails (pulley-docs-37) are a built-in notification behavior, not a user-defined recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
